witnesses.note: Passio SS. Perpetuae et Felicitatis. Latin is the copy-text throughout (Perpetua's own hand in II-X, Saturus in XI-XIII, redactor in I and XIV-XXI); Gebhardt's facing Greek is a version, cited only as a secondary witness where it clarifies. The Greek heading dates the сохранение to Valerian and Gallienus; the Latin preface is undated and the passion belongs to Severus (203) — noted, not imported.
